# TrueCalci — Precision Global, Household & Engineering Calculator Suite
> https://truecalci.com (Local: http://localhost:4000)

TrueCalci is an ultra-fast, minimalist, high-precision web computational suite engineered for global households, US homebuyers, European taxpayers, Indian investors, and engineering students.

## Core Calculators Available

### 1. Global & US Essentials Suite
- **US Mortgage Calculator (PITI & PMI)**:
  - Principal & Interest: Standard monthly fixed annuity amortization ($P \cdot \frac{r(1+r)^n}{(1+r)^n - 1}$).
  - Property Tax: Annual percentage divided by 12.
  - Homeowners Insurance: Hazard insurance divided by 12.
  - Private Mortgage Insurance (PMI): Automatically calculated when Down Payment < 20% of Home Value. Zero PMI when Down Payment ≥ 20%.
  - Full 30-year and 15-year year-by-year amortization schedules.
- **VAT & Sales Tax Calculator (EU / UK / US / Canada / Australia)**:
  - Add VAT (Net to Gross): $Gross = Net \times (1 + \frac{Rate}{100})$.
  - Remove VAT (Gross to Net): $Net = \frac{Gross}{1 + \frac{Rate}{100}}$, $VAT = Gross - Net$.
  - Official presets for UK (20%), Germany (19%), France (20%), Spain (21%), Italy (22%), US average (7.25%), Canada (13%), Australia (10%).
- **Tip & Restaurant Bill Splitter**:
  - Itemized and overall bill splitting with customizable tip percentages (10%, 15%, 18%, 20%, 25%) and per-guest total allocation.
- **Compound Wealth & 401(k) / ETF Simulator**:
  - Future Value exponential compounding: $FV = P(1+r/n)^{nt} + PMT \left[\frac{(1+r/n)^{nt}-1}{r/n}\right]$.
  - Supports 401(k), Roth IRA, UK ISA, and European ETF Sparplan savings plans.

### 2. Indian Personal Finance & Tax Suite
- **Income Tax Calculator (Budget 2025-26 & 2026-27)**: Computes New Tax Regime (default) vs Old Tax Regime. Standard deduction of ₹75,000 for salaried employees, Section 87A rebate up to ₹60,000 (effectively zero net tax up to ₹12.75 Lakhs for salaried taxpayers).
- **SIP & Step-Up SIP (Systematic Investment Plan)**: Mutual fund compounding annuity calculations with customizable annual step-up percentage, wealth gain breakdown charts, and year-by-year schedule with CSV export.
- **Home Loan / EMI & Amortization Calculator**: Reducing balance EMI calculations with month-by-month and year-by-year amortization schedules and prepayment interest savings simulator.
- **Indian Gold & Jewellery Billing**: 24K, 22K (916 Hallmark), 18K purity gold value, making charges (% or ₹/g), BIS Hallmarking fee (₹45), and 3% statutory GST.
- **PPF (Public Provident Fund)**: 15-year statutory government small savings scheme at 7.1% p.a. compounded annually with the 5th-of-the-month deposit rule.
- **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)**: Government girl child welfare scheme at 8.2% p.a. with 15-year deposit tenure and 21-year maturity.
- **Fixed Deposit (FD)**: Indian banking standards quarterly compounding.
- **GST Calculator (India)**: 5%, 12%, 18%, 28% tax slabs with 50-50 CGST and SGST breakdown.
- **Indian Land Measurement Units**: Conversion between Gaj (Square Yard = 9 Sq Ft), Guntha (121 Gaj = 1,089 Sq Ft), Bigha (Standard 3,025 Gaj = 27,225 Sq Ft), Cent (435.6 Sq Ft), Acre, and Square Metres.

### 3. Engineering Student Scientific Calci (991 Standard V.P.A.M.)
- High-fidelity physical scientific calculator modeled after the non-programmable standard 991-style engineering college calculator permitted in GATE and university exams.
- S-V.P.A.M. 2-line display with status indicators (`S`, `A`, `M`, `STO`, `D`, `R`, `G`).
- Replay 4-way D-Pad for inline expression editing and calculation history recall.
- Polynomial quadratic ($ax^2 + bx + c = 0$) and cubic equation solvers.
- Simultaneous linear equations in 2 and 3 unknowns.
- Numerical calculus: definite integration ($\int dx$) via Simpson's 1/3 composite rule and differentiation ($\frac{d}{dx}$) via central difference.
- Newton-Raphson numerical `SOLVE` function.

### 4. Commercial Desktop & Programmer Calculators
- **Desktop Arithmetic Calculator**: Standard memory registers ($M+, M-, MR, MC$), percentage semantics, square root, reciprocal.
- **64-Bit Programmer Calculator**: Real-time Hex, Dec, Oct, Bin conversion, and an interactive 64-bit clickable bitboard (bits 0..63) with bitwise logic shifts.

## Compliance & Disclaimer
All return rates and interest rates are illustrative benchmarks. TrueCalci does not provide financial or tax advisory services. Regulated under SEBI norms.
